page_title: FRE 1-4 DOR | Freiburg v Dortmund 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' 1 - 4 Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
85' The statistic for corner kicks – 3:4.
82' Dortmund fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
81' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) pounces on the cross and fires in a shot on goal from close range, but Florian Muller is alert and makes a decent save.
80' Substitution. Almugera Kabar (Dortmund) on for Daniel Svensson.
79' Substitution. Patrick Osterhage will be replaced by Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg).
79' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo will be replaced by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
79' Junior Adamu comes off the pitch to be replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg).
78' 0 - 4 Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) reacts well to a deflected cross from Julian Ryerson and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the left of the goal. 0:4.
77' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.
73' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
73' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:4.

72' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
70' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) replacing Philipp Lienhart.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Adeyemi departs the field of play to be replaced by Jamie Gittens (Dortmund).
70' The referee signals a substitution. Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is brought on as a substitute for Carney Chukwuemeka.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) comes onto the pitch for Lucas Holer.
68' 0 - 3 Goal! Julian Brandt puts the ball on a plate for Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 0:3.
66' The game is interrupted as Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is flagged offside.
65' Felix Zwayer shows the yellow card to Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) for a heavy challenge.
63' What a big chance! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
61' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Ramy Bensebaini and he is replaced by Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) replaces Maximilian Beier.
59' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Total attempts – 6:12.
55' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
51' 0 - 2 Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Florian Muller. 0:2.
49' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
47' The referee points to the corner flag and Dortmund will take a corner.

46' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel pulls off an easy save.
46' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Dortmund have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+2' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Emre Can (Dortmund), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
42' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
40' Rough tackle by Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Felix Zwayer couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Junior Adamu (Freiburg) and blew his whistle.
34' 0 - 1 Goal! Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the middle of the net.
34' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Dortmund, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
32' Felix Zwayer has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lukas Kubler (Freiburg).
27' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
26' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
24' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
22' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
20' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
18' One of the Freiburg players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
14' Flag goes up against Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' Dortmund take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
11' The ball is cleared after Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Florian Muller pulls off a great save to block a header from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) after a nice lofted cross.
8' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
4' The foul by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) was seen by Felix Zwayer who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Dortmund will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Felix Zwayer.
